description: List the demo apps Last Price runs on its own site under /demos (a SaaS plan page, an agent bank, an AI API, a storefront, a freelancer marketplace and a course platform): for each, its name, page URL, whether it is live, and the pricing experiment it runs in the Last Price demo workspace (key, name, arm names, and the visitors and conversions each arm has recorded). Open a page to see an experiment from the shopper's side before building your own. Public: needs no credential.
name: list_hosted_demos
